The '''Sooncanoo system''' was located in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="Location" /> During the [[Waymancy Storm]]<ref name="Author's Cut" /> of [[7811 BBY]],<ref name="EGTW" /> the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] contained the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|hyperspace beacon]] known as [[Sooncanoo Beacon]].<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The system later fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sooncanoo system was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square K-8.<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>
